notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.
